blocks.zh: Learning Objectives | 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 完成本節學習後，您將能夠：
blocks.en: After completing this section, you will be able to:

blocks.zh: 定義第一階段，說明其在三階段生命週期模型中的角色
blocks.en: Define Stage 1 and explain its role in the three-stage lifecycle model

blocks.zh: 識別製程知識的來源，以及如何導入第一階段
blocks.en: Identify the sources of process knowledge and how they feed into Stage 1

blocks.zh: 解釋DOE研究如何產生製程理解
blocks.en: Explain how DOE studies generate process understanding

blocks.zh: 區分NOR（正常操作範圍）與PAR（已證明可接受範圍）
blocks.en: Distinguish between NOR (normal operating range) and PAR (proven acceptable range)

blocks.zh: 描述CPP與CQA的關係
blocks.en: Describe the relationship between CPPs and CQAs

blocks.zh: 說明從試產規模放大至商業規模的注意事項
blocks.en: Explain the considerations when scaling up from pilot scale to commercial scale

blocks.zh: 概述製程設計報告應包含的內容
blocks.en: Outline what a process design report should contain

blocks.zh: 將第一階段原則應用於CDMO技術轉移情境
blocks.en: Apply Stage 1 principles to CDMO technology transfer scenarios

blocks.zh:
Key Message | 核心訊息
Process design is where you build quality in — the rigor of Stage 1 directly determines the extent of Stage 2 qualification needed.
製程設計是「品質導入」的關鍵階段——第一階段的嚴謹程度，直接決定第二階段確效所需的工作量。
blocks.en:
Key Message
Process design is where you build quality in — the rigor of Stage 1 directly determines the extent of Stage 2 qualification needed.
Process design is the critical stage where quality is built in; the rigor of Stage 1 directly determines how much validation work Stage 2 requires.

blocks.zh: Stage 1: Process Design — Overview | 第一階段：製程設計概覽
blocks.en: Stage 1: Process Design — Overview

blocks.zh: 中文解析：第一階段定義與地位
blocks.en: Commentary: Definition and Position of Stage 1

blocks.zh: 什麼是第一階段？
blocks.en: What is Stage 1?

blocks.zh: Stage 1（製程設計）是整個製程確效生命週期的「知識建構期」。在這個階段，您定義商業化生產製程——決定用哪些參數、哪個範圍、怎麼控制。
blocks.en: Stage 1 (process design) is the knowledge-building phase of the entire process validation lifecycle. In this stage you define the commercial manufacturing process: which parameters to use, what ranges, and how to control them.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Stage 1 就像蓋房子前的「建築設計圖」階段。你在這裡決定結構、材料、承重規格，後續的施工（Stage 2）和居住監測（Stage 3）都依此進行。
blocks.en: Analogy: Stage 1 is like the architectural design phase before building a house. This is where you decide the structure, materials and load-bearing specifications, and all later construction (Stage 2) and occupancy monitoring (Stage 3) follow from it.

blocks.zh: 三階段生命週期快速回顧
blocks.en: Quick Recap of the Three-Stage Lifecycle

blocks.zh: Stage 1 — 製程設計：建立製程知識與管控策略
blocks.en: Stage 1 - Process Design: Build process knowledge and a control strategy

blocks.zh: Stage 2 — 製程確效：在商業規模證明製程可重現
blocks.en: Stage 2 - Process Qualification: Demonstrate at commercial scale that the process is reproducible

blocks.zh: Stage 3 — 持續製程驗證：上市後持續監控製程狀態
blocks.en: Stage 3 - Continued Process Verification: Continuously monitor the state of control of the process after launch

blocks.zh: FDA的核心邏輯：Stage 1做得越扎實，Stage 2需要的批次數越少，Stage 3的問題也越少。
blocks.en: FDA's core logic: the more solid the Stage 1 work, the fewer batches Stage 2 needs and the fewer problems arise in Stage 3.

blocks.zh: CGMP要求的例外情況
blocks.en: Exceptions to the CGMP Requirements

blocks.zh: 早期製程設計實驗（如實驗室小試）不需完整CGMP條件，但有一個重要例外：
blocks.en: Early process design experiments (such as small-scale laboratory studies) do not need to be run under full CGMP conditions, but there is one important exception:

blocks.zh: 病毒清除研究（Viral Clearance）和雜質清除研究（Impurity Clearance）即使在小規模進行，也必須有品質單位（QU）的監督，確保方法的科學性和結論的可信度。
blocks.en: Viral clearance studies and impurity clearance studies must be overseen by the quality unit (QU) even when performed at small scale, to ensure the scientific soundness of the methods and the reliability of the conclusions.

blocks.zh: 原因：這類研究直接推算商業規模的產品品質，馬虎不得。
blocks.en: Reason: these studies are used to project product quality at commercial scale directly, so there is no room for carelessness.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 1
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise 1

blocks.zh: Stage 1的輸出會反映在哪份文件中？這份文件對商業生產有什麼意義？
blocks.en: In which document are the outputs of Stage 1 reflected? What does this document mean for commercial manufacturing?

blocks.zh: 為什麼FDA允許早期設計實驗不在CGMP條件下進行，但同時要求病毒清除研究必須有QU監督？背後的邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does FDA allow early design experiments to be run outside CGMP conditions, yet require QU oversight of viral clearance studies? What is the logic behind this?

blocks.zh: 如果一家CDMO在Stage 1投入的資源不足，對Stage 2和Stage 3分別會產生什麼影響？
blocks.en: If a CDMO invests insufficient resources in Stage 1, what are the consequences for Stage 2 and Stage 3, respectively?

blocks.zh: Building and Capturing Process Knowledge | 建立與記錄製程知識
blocks.en: Building and Capturing Process Knowledge

blocks.zh: 中文解析：製程知識的來源與變異管理
blocks.en: Commentary: Sources of Process Knowledge and Variability Management

blocks.zh: 製程知識的四大來源
blocks.en: Four Major Sources of Process Knowledge

blocks.zh: 開發數據（Development Data）：配方開發、劑型研究、初步可行性試驗的結果
blocks.en: Development data: Results of formulation development, dosage form studies and preliminary feasibility trials

blocks.zh: 文獻資料（Literature）：學術論文、監管指引、技術標準
blocks.en: Literature: Academic papers, regulatory guidance and technical standards

blocks.zh: 先前經驗（Prior Experience）：公司內部相似產品的製造歷史、平台製程
blocks.en: Prior experience: Manufacturing history of similar products within the company, and platform processes

blocks.zh: 製造歷史（Manufacturing History）：既有批次記錄、偏差調查、CAPA結果
blocks.en: Manufacturing history: Existing batch records, deviation investigations and CAPA outcomes

blocks.zh: 四大變異來源（Variability Sources）
blocks.en: Four Sources of Variability

blocks.zh: FDA特別點名這四個商業生產中的主要變異來源：
blocks.en: FDA specifically names these four major sources of variability in commercial manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 不同原料批次（Component Lots）：例如API粒徑批次間差異
blocks.en: Component lots: For example, lot-to-lot differences in API particle size

blocks.zh: 操作員（Operators）：不同人員的操作差異、培訓一致性
blocks.en: Operators: Differences in how individuals perform operations, and consistency of training

blocks.zh: 環境條件（Environmental Conditions）：溫濕度、空調系統季節性變化
blocks.en: Environmental conditions: Temperature, humidity and seasonal variation of the HVAC system

blocks.zh: 量測系統（Measurement Systems）：儀器校正、分析方法精密度
blocks.en: Measurement systems: Instrument calibration and precision of analytical methods

blocks.zh: 關鍵認知：Stage 1時，商業規模的完整變異範圍通常還不完全清楚——這是正常的，用實驗室或試產規模去估計。
blocks.en: Key insight: at the time of Stage 1, the full range of variability at commercial scale is usually not completely known. This is normal; it is estimated from laboratory or pilot-scale work.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：知識轉入的挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: The Challenge of Knowledge Transfer

blocks.zh: 在CDMO環境下，製程知識通常從委託方（Sponsor/Client）轉入。這帶來特有挑戰：
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, process knowledge is usually transferred in from the sponsor (client). This creates particular challenges:

blocks.zh: 委託方的開發數據可能不完整或格式不一
blocks.en: The sponsor's development data may be incomplete or inconsistently formatted

blocks.zh: 委託方的「先前經驗」可能是商業機密，不完全分享
blocks.en: The sponsor's "prior experience" may be trade secret and not fully shared

blocks.zh: CDMO自己的設備（如灌封機型號）可能與原開發設備不同
blocks.en: The CDMO's own equipment (for example, the filling machine model) may differ from the original development equipment

blocks.zh: 環境條件（如廠房等級、空調設計）也可能有差異
blocks.en: Environmental conditions (such as facility classification and HVAC design) may also differ

blocks.zh: 因此，CDMO的Stage 1必須重新評估這些差異對製程的影響，不能直接沿用委託方的舊數據。
blocks.en: Therefore, the CDMO's Stage 1 must re-evaluate the impact of these differences on the process; it cannot simply carry over the sponsor's old data.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 2
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise 2

blocks.zh: 您正在接受一個新產品的技術轉移，委託方給了您一份完整的開發報告，但報告中的所有試驗都在他們的實驗室設備上進行。哪些變異來源需要在您的製程設計中重新評估？
blocks.en: You are receiving a technology transfer for a new product. The sponsor has given you a complete development report, but all of the studies in it were run on their laboratory equipment. Which sources of variability need to be re-evaluated in your process design?

blocks.zh: FDA說「商業生產的完整變異範圍在Stage 1通常不清楚」——那為什麼我們還要盡力去估計它？不做這個評估，Stage 2會發生什麼事？
blocks.en: FDA says that "the full range of variability in commercial production is often not known at Stage 1". Why, then, should we still make every effort to estimate it? What happens in Stage 2 if this evaluation is not done?

blocks.zh: Stage 1的文件記錄應該包含哪些核心內容？為什麼「決策理由（rationale）」比「決策結果」更重要？
blocks.en: What core content should Stage 1 documentation include? Why is the decision rationale more important than the decision outcome?

blocks.zh: DOE Studies and Risk Analysis Tools | 實驗設計與風險分析工具
blocks.en: DOE Studies and Risk Analysis Tools

blocks.zh: 中文解析：DOE方法論與製程理解
blocks.en: Commentary: DOE Methodology and Process Understanding

blocks.zh: DOE的核心價值
blocks.en: The Core Value of DOE

blocks.zh: DOE（實驗設計，Design of Experiment）不是盲目試誤，而是用統計方法同時研究多個因素的影響和交互作用。
blocks.en: DOE (design of experiments) is not blind trial and error; it uses statistical methods to study the effects and interactions of multiple factors at the same time.

blocks.zh: 比較：
blocks.en: Comparison:

blocks.zh: 傳統OFAT（One Factor at a Time）：每次只改一個變數，看不出交互作用，需要大量實驗
blocks.en: Traditional OFAT (one factor at a time): Changes only one variable per run, cannot reveal interactions, and requires a large number of experiments

blocks.zh: DOE：同時改變多個變數，用最少實驗次數找出最重要的因素及其組合效應
blocks.en: DOE: Changes multiple variables simultaneously and uses the fewest experimental runs to identify the most important factors and their combined effects

blocks.zh: DOE在無菌製程中的應用示例
blocks.en: Example of DOE in Aseptic Processing

blocks.zh: 以無菌灌封為例，DOE可以同時研究：
blocks.en: Taking aseptic filling as an example, a DOE can study at the same time:

blocks.zh: 灌封速度（Fill speed）× 針頭間距（Needle spacing）
blocks.en: Fill speed × needle spacing

blocks.zh: 溶液溫度（Solution temp）× 灌封重量（Fill weight）
blocks.en: Solution temperature × fill weight

blocks.zh: 氮氣沖洗壓力（N₂ purge pressure）× 頂空氧含量（Headspace O₂）
blocks.en: Nitrogen purge pressure × headspace oxygen

blocks.zh: 輸出（Output）可以是：灌封重量準確性、顆粒計數、頂空含氧量——即CQA。
blocks.en: Outputs can be fill weight accuracy, particle counts and headspace oxygen content, that is, CQAs.

blocks.zh: 透過DOE，找出哪些CPP對CQA有顯著影響（主效應），以及哪些組合有交互作用（交互效應）。
blocks.en: Through DOE, you identify which CPPs have a significant effect on CQAs (main effects) and which combinations show interactions (interaction effects).

blocks.zh: 風險工具 → DOE的篩選步驟
blocks.en: Risk Tools -> Screening Step for DOE

blocks.zh: 先用風險工具（如FMEA、魚骨圖、風險矩陣）列出所有潛在因素，再篩選進入DOE，可大幅減少實驗次數：
blocks.en: First use risk tools (such as FMEA, fishbone diagrams and risk matrices) to list all potential factors, then screen those that go into the DOE. This can greatly reduce the number of experiments:

blocks.zh: 典型流程：
blocks.en: Typical flow:

blocks.zh:
列出所有因素
Ishikawa / Brainstorming → FMEA/風險評分
篩出高風險因素 → 設計DOE
高風險因素入選 → 分析結果
確定CPP
blocks.en:
List all factors
Ishikawa / Brainstorming → FMEA/risk scoring
Screen out high-risk factors → Design the DOE
High-risk factors selected → Analyze results
Determine CPPs

blocks.zh: 「不需要做到失敗」的FDA立場
blocks.en: FDA's Position: "No Need to Test to Failure"

blocks.zh: FDA明確表示：不期望廠商去找製程的「崩潰邊界」（failure boundary）。
blocks.en: FDA states clearly that it does not expect manufacturers to seek out the failure boundary of the process.

blocks.zh: 實務意涵：您需要的是建立足夠的操作空間讓正常變異有緩衝，而不是找出「最極限能接受的條件」。監管官員看的是您的理解是否足以合理設定控制範圍，不是您跑了多少個失敗批次。
blocks.en: Practical implication: what you need is to establish enough operating space to buffer normal variability, not to find the "most extreme acceptable condition". Regulators look at whether your understanding is sufficient to set control ranges reasonably, not at how many failed batches you have run.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise 3

blocks.zh: 一個無菌製造製程有20個潛在影響因素，如果每個因素用OFAT方法研究需要多少實驗？DOE能如何減少這個數字？
blocks.en: An aseptic manufacturing process has 20 potential influencing factors. How many experiments would be needed if each factor were studied with OFAT? How can DOE reduce this number?

blocks.zh: 電腦模擬（in silico simulation）在Stage 1中的角色是什麼？它能完全取代實際實驗嗎？為什麼FDA要求廠商理解模型與商業製程的差異？
blocks.en: What is the role of in silico simulation in Stage 1? Can it completely replace actual experiments? Why does FDA require manufacturers to understand the differences between the model and the commercial process?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「風險分析工具先行，DOE後行」的順序在監管上是合理的？如果順序反過來會有什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why is the order "risk analysis tools first, DOE second" reasonable from a regulatory standpoint? What problems would arise if the order were reversed?

blocks.zh: CPP / CQA Mapping | 關鍵製程參數與品質屬性對應
blocks.en: CPP / CQA Mapping

blocks.zh: 如何在Stage 1識別CPP？
blocks.en: How Are CPPs Identified in Stage 1?

blocks.zh: CPP識別工作流程
blocks.en: CPP Identification Workflow

blocks.zh:
Step 1：列出所有製程參數
每個單元操作的所有輸入變數
blocks.en:
Step 1: List all process parameters
All input variables of each unit operation

blocks.zh:
Step 2：風險評估
FMEA / 影響評估 / 科學判斷
blocks.en:
Step 2: Risk assessment
FMEA / impact assessment / scientific judgment

blocks.zh:
Step 3：DOE驗證
實驗確認哪些參數對CQA有顯著影響
blocks.en:
Step 3: DOE verification
Confirm experimentally which parameters significantly affect CQAs

blocks.zh:
Step 4：分類
CPP（關鍵）vs. KPP（重要）vs. 非關鍵
blocks.en:
Step 4: Classification
CPP (critical) vs. KPP (key) vs. non-critical

blocks.zh:
Step 5：設定NOR & PAR
定義操作範圍並記錄於製程設計報告
blocks.en:
Step 5: Set NOR & PAR
Define operating ranges and record them in the process design report

blocks.zh: 很多公司區分兩個層次：
blocks.en: Many companies distinguish two levels:

blocks.zh: CPP（Critical）：變動直接影響CQA，必須嚴格管控，偏離需要立即調查
blocks.en: CPP (Critical): Variation directly affects CQAs; must be tightly controlled, and deviations require immediate investigation

blocks.zh: KPP（Key/Important）：重要但變動不直接引起CQA失效，需要監控但管控強度較低
blocks.en: KPP (Key/Important): Important, but variation does not directly cause a CQA failure; needs monitoring but with a lower level of control

blocks.zh: FDA的Guidance本身沒有強制要求這個區分，但ICH Q8/Q11對此有更詳細的討論。在Stage 1中，確認哪些是真正的CPP，對於Stage 2的PPQ（製程效能確效）批次的管控計畫設計至關重要。
blocks.en: FDA's guidance itself does not mandate this distinction, but ICH Q8/Q11 discuss it in more detail. In Stage 1, confirming which parameters are true CPPs is essential for designing the control plan for the Stage 2 PPQ (process performance qualification) batches.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 4
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise 4

blocks.zh: 一個凍乾產品，委託方說「架板降溫速率（shelf ramp rate）是CPP」，但沒有提供DOE數據，只有開發人員的經驗判斷。在CDMO的技術轉移中，您如何處理這個情況？
blocks.en: For a lyophilized product, the sponsor says "shelf ramp rate is a CPP" but provides no DOE data, only the developers' experience-based judgment. How do you handle this situation in the CDMO technology transfer?

blocks.zh: 表中「視覺檢查」單元被標示為Medium風險——但視覺檢查的目的是檢測微粒（與患者安全直接相關）。為什麼其CPP可能被評為中等而非高等風險？
blocks.en: In the table, the "visual inspection" unit is rated as Medium risk, yet the purpose of visual inspection is to detect particulates (directly related to patient safety). Why might its CPPs be rated medium rather than high risk?

blocks.zh: 如果一個CPP在Stage 1被遺漏（未識別），最可能在哪個階段被發現？發現時可能造成什麼後果？
blocks.en: If a CPP is missed (not identified) in Stage 1, at which stage is it most likely to be discovered? What consequences might follow?

blocks.zh: CPP / CQA Mapping Table — Sterile Fill-Finish | 無菌製程CPP/CQA對應表
blocks.en: CPP / CQA Mapping Table — Sterile Fill-Finish

blocks.zh: NOR vs PAR — Operating Ranges | 操作範圍定義與比較
blocks.en: NOR vs PAR — Operating Ranges

blocks.zh: 中文解析：NOR、PAR與設計空間的關係
blocks.en: Commentary: The Relationship Between NOR, PAR and Design Space

blocks.zh: 比喻：高速公路行駛
blocks.en: Analogy: Driving on a Highway

blocks.zh: 想像開車在高速公路：
blocks.en: Imagine driving on a highway:

blocks.zh: PAR = 法定速限範圍（例如：60–120 km/h），在這個範圍內行駛都是合法的、被證明安全的
blocks.en: PAR = the legal speed range (for example, 60-120 km/h); driving anywhere within it is legal and proven safe

blocks.zh: NOR = 您公司的車隊管理規定（例如：80–100 km/h），這是日常正常操作區間，給突發狀況留有緩衝
blocks.en: NOR = your company's fleet management rule (for example, 80-100 km/h); this is the normal day-to-day operating band, leaving a buffer for unexpected situations

blocks.zh: 平常開車（商業生產）在NOR（80-100）。偶爾因超車需要到NOR以外但還在PAR以內（如110km/h）？需要評估，但不一定違規。超出PAR（超過120km/h）？那就是真正的問題了。
blocks.en: Normal driving (commercial production) is within the NOR (80-100). Occasionally going outside the NOR but still within the PAR (for example, 110 km/h) to overtake? That needs to be assessed, but it is not necessarily a violation. Going beyond the PAR (over 120 km/h)? That is a real problem.

blocks.zh: 設計空間（Design Space）
blocks.en: Design Space

blocks.zh: ICH Q8(R2) 定義的設計空間是比PAR更高層次的概念：
blocks.en: The design space defined in ICH Q8(R2) is a higher-level concept than PAR:

blocks.zh: 設計空間 = 多個CPP和物料屬性的多維組合空間，在此空間內操作可保證產品品質
blocks.en: Design space = the multidimensional combination space of multiple CPPs and material attributes within which operation assures product quality

blocks.zh: PAR = 單一參數的可接受範圍（一維）
blocks.en: PAR = the acceptable range of a single parameter (one-dimensional)

blocks.zh: 設計空間需要考慮參數間的交互作用（多維）
blocks.en: The design space must account for interactions between parameters (multidimensional)

blocks.zh: 在設計空間內移動（如調整某個CPP）不視為變更（Change），不需要監管提交審批。超出設計空間則需要Post-Approval Change（PAC）。
blocks.en: Movement within the design space (such as adjusting a CPP) is not considered a change and does not require regulatory submission or approval. Moving outside the design space requires a post-approval change (PAC).

blocks.zh: NOR設定的實務建議
blocks.en: Practical Advice on Setting the NOR

blocks.zh: NOR應設在PAR的中間偏窄，確保：
blocks.en: The NOR should be set in the middle of the PAR and narrower than it, to ensure that:

blocks.zh: 正常生產變異（儀器精度、操作員差異）不會超出NOR
blocks.en: Normal production variability (instrument precision, operator differences) does not exceed the NOR

blocks.zh: NOR超出到PAR邊界有足夠緩衝空間
blocks.en: There is sufficient buffer between the NOR and the PAR boundary

blocks.zh: NOR到PAR邊界的距離 ≥ 製程正常變異的3倍標準差（作為經驗法則）
blocks.en: The distance from the NOR to the PAR boundary is at least 3 standard deviations of normal process variability (as a rule of thumb)

blocks.zh: 如果NOR設得太靠近PAR邊界，生產中偶爾的正常波動就會觸發偏差——導致不必要的調查負擔。
blocks.en: If the NOR is set too close to the PAR boundary, occasional normal fluctuations in production will trigger deviations, creating an unnecessary investigation burden.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 5
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise 5

blocks.zh: 一個灌封重量的PAR是4.90–5.10 mL，NOR是4.95–5.05 mL。某批次灌封速度因設備問題暫時降低，導致平均灌封量升至5.08 mL。這是偏差嗎？需要調查嗎？您如何判斷？
blocks.en: The PAR for fill weight is 4.90-5.10 mL and the NOR is 4.95-5.05 mL. For one batch, the filling speed was temporarily reduced because of an equipment problem, and the mean fill volume rose to 5.08 mL. Is this a deviation? Does it need investigation? How do you decide?

blocks.zh: 在CDMO的法規申報（NDA/BLA）支持中，PAR數據通常放在CTD的哪個模組？誰負責提供這些數據——CDMO還是Sponsor？
blocks.en: When supporting a regulatory filing (NDA/BLA) for a CDMO, in which CTD module are PAR data usually placed? Who is responsible for providing these data, the CDMO or the sponsor?

blocks.zh: 如果一個公司在Stage 1只設定了NOR，沒有建立PAR，Stage 2和Stage 3會面臨什麼風險？
blocks.en: If a company sets only a NOR in Stage 1 and does not establish a PAR, what risks will it face in Stage 2 and Stage 3?

blocks.zh: Process Design Space and Operating Space | 製程設計空間與操作空間
blocks.en: Process Design Space and Operating Space

blocks.zh: 中文解析：設計空間的三層結構
blocks.en: Commentary: The Three-Layer Structure of Design Space

blocks.zh: 製程空間三層結構（由外到內）
blocks.en: Three-Layer Structure of Process Space (Outside In)

blocks.zh:
知識空間（Knowledge Space）
所有探索過的條件範圍，包含失敗邊界
blocks.en:
Knowledge Space
All condition ranges explored, including failure boundaries

blocks.zh: ↓ 縮小到
blocks.en: ↓ Narrowing to

blocks.zh:
設計空間（Design Space / ICH Q8）
有科學數據支持品質保證的多維空間
在此空間內移動 ≠ 法規變更
blocks.en:
Design Space (ICH Q8)
Multidimensional space supported by scientific data to assure quality
Movement within this space is not a regulatory change

blocks.zh:
操作空間 / NOR
日常商業生產控制範圍
偏離需要偏差調查
blocks.en:
Operating Space / NOR
Routine commercial production control range
Deviations require a deviation investigation

blocks.zh: CDMO的設計空間策略
blocks.en: Design Space Strategy for CDMOs

blocks.zh: CDMO在技術轉移後，可能面臨設計空間的爭議：
blocks.en: After technology transfer, a CDMO may face disputes over the design space:

blocks.zh: 情境1：Sponsor已在IND/NDA中申報了設計空間，CDMO必須在此空間內操作
blocks.en: Scenario 1: The sponsor has filed a design space in the IND/NDA, and the CDMO must operate within it

blocks.zh: 情境2：Sponsor沒有正式設計空間，只有NOR。CDMO若想擴展，需要在技術轉移協議中明確責任分工
blocks.en: Scenario 2: The sponsor has no formal design space, only a NOR. If the CDMO wants to extend it, the division of responsibilities must be clearly defined in the technology transfer agreement

blocks.zh: 情境3：CDMO自己的設備特性（如不同廠牌的灌封機）可能需要重新確認NOR，甚至影響原有設計空間的適用性
blocks.en: Scenario 3: The CDMO's own equipment characteristics (such as a different make of filling machine) may require the NOR to be re-confirmed, and may even affect the applicability of the original design space

blocks.zh: 建議：技術轉移前，CDMO應要求Sponsor提供完整的製程設計報告（Process Design Report），包含所有CPP的PAR數據和設計空間依據。
blocks.en: Recommendation: before technology transfer, the CDMO should ask the sponsor for a complete Process Design Report, including the PAR data for all CPPs and the basis for the design space.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 6
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise 6

blocks.zh: 如果Sponsor在Stage 1建立了正式的設計空間，並在NDA中申報。CDMO在技術轉移後，想將灌封溫度從設計空間邊界內調整到邊界外（為了配合CDMO的設備特性），需要做什麼步驟？
blocks.en: Suppose the sponsor established a formal design space in Stage 1 and filed it in the NDA. After technology transfer, the CDMO wants to move the fill temperature from within the design space boundary to outside it (to suit the CDMO's equipment characteristics). What steps are required?

blocks.zh: 「在設計空間內移動不需要監管提交」——這對CDMO的商業價值是什麼？客戶（Sponsor）如何從中受益？
blocks.en: What is the commercial value to the CDMO of "movement within the design space does not require regulatory submission"? How does the client (sponsor) benefit?

blocks.zh: 如果一個產品的Stage 1工作非常有限（如快速開發的孤兒藥），設計空間幾乎沒有建立，Stage 2和Stage 3應該如何補充這個差距？
blocks.en: If a product has very limited Stage 1 work (such as an orphan drug under rapid development) and almost no design space has been established, how should Stage 2 and Stage 3 make up for this gap?

blocks.zh: Material Attributes | 物料屬性與製程的關係
blocks.en: Material Attributes

blocks.zh: 中文解析：物料屬性對製程的衝擊
blocks.en: Commentary: The Impact of Material Attributes on the Process

blocks.zh: CMA（Critical Material Attribute）的概念
blocks.en: The Concept of CMA (Critical Material Attribute)

blocks.zh: 就像製程有CPP，原料也有關鍵物料屬性（CMA）。CMA是指原料的特性，其變動會直接影響製程效能或產品CQA。
blocks.en: Just as the process has CPPs, raw materials have critical material attributes (CMAs). A CMA is a property of a raw material whose variation directly affects process performance or the product CQAs.

blocks.zh: CMA的管控思路：
blocks.en: Approach to controlling CMAs:

blocks.zh: 在收貨時（IQC）設定供應商規格，確保符合CMA範圍
blocks.en: At receipt (IQC), set supplier specifications to ensure the CMA range is met

blocks.zh: 在Stage 1中，用DOE研究CMA的可接受範圍
blocks.en: In Stage 1, use DOE to study the acceptable range of CMAs

blocks.zh: 批次間原料變異→ 是商業生產變異的主要來源之一
blocks.en: Lot-to-lot raw material variability -> is one of the main sources of variability in commercial production

blocks.zh: CDMO場景：原料批次變異的挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: The Challenge of Raw Material Lot Variability

blocks.zh: CDMO通常不控制原料採購（由Sponsor決定供應商），但必須管控原料批次間的變異對製程的影響：
blocks.en: A CDMO usually does not control raw material purchasing (the sponsor chooses the suppliers), but it must control the impact of lot-to-lot raw material variability on the process:

blocks.zh: 問題：Sponsor更換API供應商，新批次粒徑分佈更寬
blocks.en: Problem: The sponsor changes API supplier, and the new lots have a wider particle size distribution

blocks.zh: 影響：溶解速率改變 → 含量均一性CQA可能受影響
blocks.en: Impact: Dissolution rate changes -> the content uniformity CQA may be affected

blocks.zh: Stage 1的防護：如果在Stage 1中已研究了API粒徑的CMA範圍（PAR），可以判斷新供應商的粒徑是否在已研究範圍內，避免盲目放行
blocks.en: Stage 1 safeguard: If the CMA range for API particle size (PAR) was already studied in Stage 1, you can judge whether the new supplier's particle size falls within the studied range and avoid releasing blindly

blocks.zh: 生物製劑的額外挑戰
blocks.en: Additional Challenges for Biologics

blocks.zh: 生物製劑（如mAb、重組蛋白）的CMA比小分子藥物複雜得多：
blocks.en: The CMAs of biologics (such as mAbs and recombinant proteins) are much more complex than those of small-molecule drugs:

blocks.zh: 蛋白質的高階結構（二級、三級、四級）難以完全表徵
blocks.en: The higher-order structure of proteins (secondary, tertiary, quaternary) is difficult to characterize completely

blocks.zh: 糖基化模式（Glycosylation pattern）可能因細胞培養條件輕微改變
blocks.en: The glycosylation pattern may change with slight alterations in cell culture conditions

blocks.zh: FDA因此對生物製劑的「不能高度表徵（cannot be highly characterized）」情況，要求更嚴格的製程內監控
blocks.en: For this reason, where a biologic "cannot be highly characterized", FDA requires more stringent in-process monitoring

blocks.zh: 這也是FDA Guidance特別提到的第二種需要特別關注控制策略的情境。
blocks.en: This is also the second situation that the FDA guidance specifically identifies as needing particular attention in the control strategy.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 7
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise 7

blocks.zh: 一個mAb（單株抗體）產品，Stage 1的設計報告中只研究了製程參數（如pH、溫度），沒有系統性研究API批次間變異（如聚集體含量差異）對灌封製程的影響。這在監管上有什麼風險？
blocks.en: For a mAb (monoclonal antibody) product, the Stage 1 design report studied only process parameters (such as pH and temperature) and did not systematically study the effect of lot-to-lot variability of the drug substance (such as differences in aggregate content) on the filling process. What regulatory risks does this carry?

blocks.zh: 橡皮塞（stopper）的尺寸公差被列為CMA之一。如果在技術轉移中，CDMO使用的供應商與Sponsor原先的供應商不同，應該做哪些額外的評估？
blocks.en: Stopper dimensional tolerance is listed as a CMA. If, in the technology transfer, the CDMO uses a different supplier from the sponsor's original one, what additional evaluations should be performed?

blocks.zh: WFI（注射用水）的TOC和內毒素通常在廠內自製管控，但如果廠內WFI系統正在維護，需要使用外購WFI，Stage 1是否需要預先研究WFI品質變化對製程的影響？
blocks.en: WFI (water for injection) TOC and endotoxin are normally controlled by the in-house system. But if the in-house WFI system is under maintenance and purchased WFI must be used, does Stage 1 need to have studied in advance the effect of WFI quality changes on the process?

blocks.zh: Scale-Up Considerations | 製程放大考量
blocks.en: Scale-Up Considerations

blocks.zh: 中文解析：放大製程的系統性思維
blocks.en: Commentary: A Systematic Approach to Scaling Up the Process

blocks.zh: 平台製程（Platform Process）的善用
blocks.en: Making Good Use of Platform Processes

blocks.zh: CDMO的核心競爭優勢之一，就是「平台製程知識」：
blocks.en: One of a CDMO's core competitive advantages is "platform process knowledge":

blocks.zh: 例如：CDMO已有10個mAb產品的無菌灌封歷史，知道在同廠牌灌封機上，灌封速度CPP的PAR通常在哪個範圍
blocks.en: For example, a CDMO that already has aseptic filling history for 10 mAb products knows the range in which the PAR of the fill speed CPP typically falls on the same make of filling machine

blocks.zh: 這些先驗知識（prior knowledge）可以縮短新產品的Stage 1工作——但必須書面記錄哪些知識可以借用，哪些需要重新確認
blocks.en: This prior knowledge can shorten the Stage 1 work for a new product, but it must be documented which knowledge can be borrowed and which needs to be re-confirmed

blocks.zh: FDA允許「已知製程的縮減實驗」，但要求廠商說明差異性評估（comparability assessment）
blocks.en: FDA allows reduced experimentation for known processes, but requires the manufacturer to explain the differences through a comparability assessment

blocks.zh: 凍乾放大的特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Special Challenges in Scaling Up Lyophilization

blocks.zh: 凍乾（Lyophilization）是最難放大的製程之一：
blocks.en: Lyophilization is one of the most difficult processes to scale up:

blocks.zh: 板架均一性（Shelf uniformity）：邊緣與中心的溫度差異在大型凍乾機中更顯著
blocks.en: Shelf uniformity: Temperature differences between the edge and the center are more pronounced in large lyophilizers

blocks.zh: 裝載量效應（Loading effect）：全載vs.半載，升華速率不同
blocks.en: Loading effect: Full load vs. half load gives different sublimation rates

blocks.zh: 設備間轉移（Equipment transfer）：實驗型凍乾機 → 商業凍乾機，參數不能直接套用
blocks.en: Equipment transfer: From laboratory lyophilizer to commercial lyophilizer, parameters cannot be applied directly

blocks.zh: ICH Q8附錄提到：設計空間可以跨越不同規模，但需要通過縮放參數（scale-dependent parameters）的研究來支持。
blocks.en: The ICH Q8 annex notes that a design space can span different scales, but this must be supported by studies of scale-dependent parameters.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 8
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise 8

blocks.zh: 一個新產品的開發批次（10 L）在實驗室凍乾機完成，您需要為商業批次（300 L，商業凍乾機）設計Stage 1放大研究。哪些參數需要重新確認？哪些可以直接轉用？
blocks.en: A development batch (10 L) of a new product was run in a laboratory lyophilizer, and you need to design the Stage 1 scale-up study for a commercial batch (300 L, commercial lyophilizer). Which parameters need to be re-confirmed? Which can be carried over directly?

blocks.zh: CDMO的「平台製程知識」要如何在Stage 1報告中正確引用，才能被FDA和客戶接受？需要提供哪些文件？
blocks.en: How should a CDMO's "platform process knowledge" be correctly referenced in the Stage 1 report so that it is accepted by FDA and the client? What documents need to be provided?

blocks.zh: 一個小分子注射劑的配製步驟，從100 L放大到1000 L，攪拌槳設計相同但尺寸放大。混合均一性（mixing uniformity）需要在Stage 1中如何重新評估？
blocks.en: For the compounding step of a small-molecule injectable scaled from 100 L to 1000 L, the agitator design is the same but enlarged in size. How should mixing uniformity be re-evaluated in Stage 1?

blocks.zh: Establishing a Strategy for Process Control | 建立製程管控策略
blocks.en: Establishing a Strategy for Process Control

blocks.zh: 中文解析：三層控制策略
blocks.en: Commentary: A Three-Layer Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 管控策略的兩大方向
blocks.en: Two Main Directions for a Control Strategy

blocks.zh: FDA明確說明，製程管控策略可以從兩個方向入手（或結合）：
blocks.en: FDA states clearly that a process control strategy can be approached from two directions (or a combination of them):

blocks.zh:
方向1：降低輸入變異（Reduce input variation）
例如：對原料設定嚴格的IQC規格，確保進料CMA的一致性；在過濾前過濾賦形劑以降低雜質；使用自動化配製減少操作員差異。
blocks.en:
Direction 1: Reduce input variation
For example: set tight IQC specifications for raw materials to ensure consistency of incoming CMAs; filter excipients before the main filtration to reduce impurities; use automated compounding to reduce operator differences.

blocks.zh:
方向2：即時調整製程（Adjust for input variation during manufacturing）
例如：使用PAT（製程分析技術）即時監測配製溶液的濃度，自動調整攪拌時間；在灌封中使用閉環控制系統自動補正灌封重量偏差。
blocks.en:
Direction 2: Adjust for input variation during manufacturing
For example: use PAT (process analytical technology) to monitor the concentration of the compounded solution in real time and automatically adjust the mixing time; use a closed-loop control system during filling to automatically correct fill weight deviations.

blocks.zh: 兩種特殊情境下的加強管控
blocks.en: Enhanced Control in Two Special Situations

blocks.zh: 情境1：產品屬性難以量測
blocks.en: Situation 1: Product attributes that are difficult to measure

blocks.zh: 無菌性（sterility）是最典型的例子——不能每支都做無菌測試（破壞性且不具代表性），所以要靠：
blocks.en: Sterility is the classic example: you cannot run a sterility test on every unit (it is destructive and not representative), so you must rely on:

blocks.zh: 嚴格的環境管控（EM監測）
blocks.en: Strict environmental control (EM monitoring)

blocks.zh: 過濾器完整性測試
blocks.en: Filter integrity testing

blocks.zh: 製程模擬（媒體填充/APS）
blocks.en: Process simulation (media fill/APS)

blocks.zh: 情境2：中間體無法完全表徵
blocks.en: Situation 2: Intermediates that cannot be fully characterized

blocks.zh: 生物製劑中間體（如細胞收穫液、純化中間體）的高階結構難以完全量測，必須依靠嚴格的製程參數管控（如pH、溫度、時間）作為品質的代理指標（surrogate）。
blocks.en: The higher-order structure of biologic intermediates (such as cell harvest fluid and purification intermediates) is difficult to measure completely, so the process must rely on tight control of process parameters (such as pH, temperature and time) as a surrogate for quality.

blocks.zh: PAT在無菌製造的應用潛力
blocks.en: Potential of PAT in Aseptic Manufacturing

blocks.zh: PAT（製程分析技術）是更先進的管控策略，在無菌製造中的應用包括：
blocks.en: PAT (process analytical technology) is a more advanced control strategy. Applications in aseptic manufacturing include:

blocks.zh: 在線濃度監測（NIR/Raman）：即時確認配製濃度，不需等離線HPLC結果
blocks.en: In-line concentration monitoring (NIR/Raman): Confirms compounding concentration in real time, without waiting for off-line HPLC results

blocks.zh: 在線粒徑監測：配製過程中確認API粒徑分佈
blocks.en: In-line particle size monitoring: Confirms the API particle size distribution during compounding

blocks.zh: 100%視覺檢查自動化：高速相機+AI影像判斷，比人工更可靠
blocks.en: Automated 100% visual inspection: High-speed cameras plus AI image evaluation, more reliable than manual inspection

blocks.zh: 灌封重量閉環控制：自動補正，減少人工調整頻率
blocks.en: Closed-loop fill weight control: Automatic correction, reducing the frequency of manual adjustments

blocks.zh: PAT的導入通常在Stage 1確定，Stage 2驗證其可靠性——這也是Stage 1投資的高回報領域。
blocks.en: The adoption of PAT is usually decided in Stage 1 and its reliability is verified in Stage 2, which makes it a high-return area for Stage 1 investment.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 9
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise 9

blocks.zh: 一個mAb的病毒清除步驟（低pH病毒滅活）難以直接量測病毒清除率，應設計哪些製程控制來代替直接量測？這些控制如何反映在Stage 1的管控策略中？
blocks.en: For the viral clearance step of a mAb (low-pH viral inactivation), the clearance rate is difficult to measure directly. What process controls should be designed in its place? How are these controls reflected in the Stage 1 control strategy?

blocks.zh: PAT的導入（如在線NIR）通常需要大量投資。CDMO應如何向客戶說明PAT的監管價值（不只是效率），以爭取客戶接受這個成本？
blocks.en: Adopting PAT (such as in-line NIR) usually requires substantial investment. How should a CDMO explain the regulatory value of PAT (not just efficiency) to win client acceptance of this cost?

blocks.zh: 「降低輸入變異」vs.「即時調整製程」——兩者在監管文件（如品質計畫、控制策略報告）中有不同的呈現方式。您如何在Stage 1報告中清楚區分並記錄？
blocks.en: "Reducing input variation" vs. "adjusting the process in real time" are presented differently in regulatory documents (such as the quality plan and the control strategy report). How would you clearly distinguish and document them in the Stage 1 report?

blocks.zh: Documentation — Process Design Report | 文件記錄：製程設計報告
blocks.en: Documentation — Process Design Report

blocks.zh: 中文解析：製程設計報告的架構
blocks.en: Commentary: Structure of the Process Design Report

blocks.zh: 「記錄決策理由」的監管重要性
blocks.en: The Regulatory Importance of "Documenting the Decision Rationale"

blocks.zh: FDA在稽查時，最常問的問題之一是：「你們為什麼選這個範圍？」
blocks.en: One of the questions FDA asks most often during inspections is: "Why did you choose this range?"

blocks.zh: 如果答案是「工程師的判斷」或「歷史慣例」，而沒有科學數據和書面理由，這會是一個重大的483觀察項。
blocks.en: If the answer is "the engineer's judgment" or "historical practice", without scientific data and a written rationale, this will be a major 483 observation.

blocks.zh: 正確的記錄方式：
blocks.en: The right way to document:

blocks.zh: 「灌封溫度NOR設定為20–25°C，基於DOE研究（Study Report XYZ-001）顯示，超過28°C時蛋白聚集體顯著增加（p<0.05），低於18°C時溶液黏度升高影響灌封準確性。PAR 15–28°C有完整數據支持。」
blocks.en: "The fill temperature NOR is set at 20-25 °C, based on a DOE study (Study Report XYZ-001) showing that protein aggregates increase significantly above 28 °C (p<0.05), and that below 18 °C increased solution viscosity affects fill accuracy. The PAR of 15-28 °C is fully supported by data."

blocks.zh: 思考練習 10
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise 10

blocks.zh: 您收到FDA的Warning Letter，提到「你們的製程設計報告缺乏對灌封速度CPP識別的科學依據」。根據Stage 1的要求，您需要補充哪些文件和數據？
blocks.en: You receive an FDA Warning Letter stating that "your process design report lacks a scientific basis for identifying filling speed as a CPP". Based on the Stage 1 requirements, what documents and data do you need to supplement?

blocks.zh: Stage 1文件在技術轉移中的角色：如果CDMO要向另一個CDMO再次轉移，Stage 1的PDR應該移交哪些部分？哪些屬於原始開發方的IP，可能不會完全開放？
blocks.en: The role of Stage 1 documentation in technology transfer: if the CDMO must transfer again to another CDMO, which parts of the Stage 1 PDR should be handed over? Which belong to the original developer's IP and may not be fully disclosed?

blocks.zh: 為什麼FDA說Stage 1文件「對Stage 2和Stage 3都有用」？給出一個具體例子說明Stage 1的某個記錄如何直接影響Stage 3的CPV監控計畫。
blocks.en: Why does FDA say that Stage 1 documentation is "useful for both Stage 2 and Stage 3"? Give a concrete example of how a particular Stage 1 record directly affects the Stage 3 CPV monitoring plan.

blocks.zh: Technology Transfer | 技術轉移
blocks.en: Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: 中文解析：CDMO技術轉移的實務框架
blocks.en: Commentary: A Practical Framework for CDMO Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: CDMO技術轉移的四個階段
blocks.en: Four Phases of CDMO Technology Transfer

blocks.zh:
Phase 1：資料評估（Document Review）
收取Sponsor的PDR、開發報告、已有數據；進行差距分析
blocks.en:
Phase 1: Document Review
Receive the sponsor's PDR, development reports and existing data; perform a gap analysis

blocks.zh:
Phase 2：製程評估（Process Assessment）
評估Sponsor製程與CDMO設備/廠房的差異；確認哪些需要重新研究
blocks.en:
Phase 2: Process Assessment
Assess differences between the sponsor's process and the CDMO's equipment/facility; confirm what needs to be re-studied

blocks.zh:
Phase 3：工程批（Engineering Runs）
在CDMO設備上驗證製程，確認CPP、NOR；必要時重新確認PAR
blocks.en:
Phase 3: Engineering Runs
Verify the process on CDMO equipment, confirm CPPs and NOR; re-confirm PAR where necessary

blocks.zh:
Phase 4：PPQ就緒（Ready for Stage 2）
更新MBR、完成設備確效、發布最終製程設計報告
blocks.en:
Phase 4: PPQ Readiness (Ready for Stage 2)
Update the MBR, complete equipment qualification, issue the final process design report

blocks.zh: 常見技術轉移失敗原因
blocks.en: Common Reasons for Technology Transfer Failure

blocks.zh: 知識未完整文件化：Sponsor有隱性知識（tacit knowledge），沒有記錄在PDR中，CDMO無從知曉
blocks.en: Knowledge not fully documented: The sponsor holds tacit knowledge that is not recorded in the PDR, so the CDMO has no way of knowing it

blocks.zh: 設備差異未評估：Sponsor用A廠牌灌封機，CDMO用B廠牌，假設CPP範圍可以直接套用
blocks.en: Equipment differences not assessed: The sponsor uses make A filling machine and the CDMO uses make B, and it is assumed that the CPP ranges can be applied directly

blocks.zh: 分析方法未轉移確認：Sponsor的HPLC方法在CDMO的儀器上未驗證，造成數據不可比
blocks.en: Analytical method transfer not confirmed: The sponsor's HPLC method was not verified on the CDMO's instruments, making the data non-comparable

blocks.zh: 工程批數量不足：未完整確認製程在CDMO條件下的可重現性，直接進入PPQ
blocks.en: Insufficient number of engineering runs: Reproducibility of the process under CDMO conditions was not fully confirmed before going directly into PPQ

blocks.zh: 人員培訓不足：CDMO操作人員未充分理解Stage 1決策背後的科學原理，只是機械性按SOP操作
blocks.en: Insufficient personnel training: CDMO operators did not adequately understand the science behind the Stage 1 decisions and simply followed SOPs mechanically

blocks.zh: 技術轉移失敗的真實代價
blocks.en: The Real Cost of Technology Transfer Failure

blocks.zh: Stage 2的PPQ批次失敗代價極高：
blocks.en: The cost of a failed Stage 2 PPQ batch is very high:

blocks.zh: 一批商業規模失敗批次可能損失數十萬至數百萬美元的原料和製造成本
blocks.en: One failed commercial-scale batch can mean the loss of hundreds of thousands to millions of dollars in materials and manufacturing cost

blocks.zh: PPQ失敗會延遲NDA/BLA申請，推遲產品上市1–2年
blocks.en: PPQ failure delays the NDA/BLA submission and postpones product launch by 1-2 years

blocks.zh: FDA可能對頻繁PPQ失敗展開合規稽查
blocks.en: FDA may launch a for-cause compliance inspection over frequent PPQ failures

blocks.zh: 結論：在Stage 1（技術轉移的工程批）投資足夠時間和資源，是CDMO最有效的風險管理。
blocks.en: Conclusion: investing sufficient time and resources in Stage 1 (the engineering runs of technology transfer) is the most effective risk management for a CDMO.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 11
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise 11

blocks.zh: 一個CDMO接受技術轉移，Sponsor提供的PDR顯示凍乾CPP（板架降溫速率）已有完整DOE數據支持，PAR為 -0.5至-1.5°C/min。但CDMO的凍乾機與Sponsor的型號不同。您如何評估原有PAR是否適用於CDMO的設備？
blocks.en: A CDMO accepts a technology transfer. The sponsor's PDR shows that the lyophilization CPP (shelf ramp rate) is supported by complete DOE data, with a PAR of -0.5 to -1.5 °C/min. However, the CDMO's lyophilizer is a different model from the sponsor's. How do you assess whether the original PAR applies to the CDMO's equipment?

blocks.zh: 如果技術轉移協議中規定「CDMO負責Stage 2 PPQ，Sponsor負責提供Stage 1 PDR」，但Stage 1 PDR發現有CPP識別不完整的問題，責任如何分擔？合約中應如何保護CDMO？
blocks.en: If the technology transfer agreement states that "the CDMO is responsible for Stage 2 PPQ and the sponsor is responsible for providing the Stage 1 PDR", but the Stage 1 PDR is found to have incomplete CPP identification, how is responsibility shared? How should the contract protect the CDMO?

blocks.zh: CDMO在完成工程批後，更新了MBR中的兩個CPP範圍（比Sponsor原始PDR更窄）。這個更新是否需要Sponsor確認？是否需要法規更新（post-approval change）？判斷依據是什麼？
blocks.en: After completing the engineering runs, the CDMO updated the ranges of two CPPs in the MBR (narrower than in the sponsor's original PDR). Does this update need sponsor confirmation? Does it require a regulatory update (post-approval change)? What is the basis for deciding?

blocks.zh: CDMO Application Summary | CDMO實務應用總結
blocks.en: CDMO Application Summary

blocks.zh: 中文總結：Stage 1的三個核心成果
blocks.en: Summary: The Three Core Outcomes of Stage 1

blocks.zh: 成果1：製程理解（Process Understanding）
blocks.en: Outcome 1: Process Understanding

blocks.zh: Stage 1結束時，您應該能夠回答：
blocks.en: At the end of Stage 1, you should be able to answer:

blocks.zh: 哪些製程參數是關鍵的（CPP）？為什麼？
blocks.en: Which process parameters are critical (CPPs)? Why?

blocks.zh: 哪些物料屬性是關鍵的（CMA）？為什麼？
blocks.en: Which material attributes are critical (CMAs)? Why?

blocks.zh: 這些參數的可接受範圍（PAR）是多少？日常範圍（NOR）是多少？
blocks.en: What is the acceptable range (PAR) of these parameters? What is the normal operating range (NOR)?

blocks.zh: 不同參數之間有什麼交互作用？
blocks.en: What interactions exist between different parameters?

blocks.zh: 成果2：管控策略（Control Strategy）
blocks.en: Outcome 2: Control Strategy

blocks.zh: Stage 1結束時，您應該有一份明確的管控策略，說明：
blocks.en: At the end of Stage 1, you should have a clear control strategy that describes:

blocks.zh: 每個單元操作的關鍵控制點
blocks.en: Critical control points for each unit operation

blocks.zh: 原料的IQC規格（基於CMA研究）
blocks.en: IQC specifications for raw materials (based on CMA studies)

blocks.zh: 製程中的監測頻率和方法
blocks.en: In-process monitoring frequency and methods

blocks.zh: 是否使用PAT（及其驗證計畫）
blocks.en: Whether PAT is used (and its validation plan)

blocks.zh: 製程限制（Operational Limits）和行動限制（Action Limits）
blocks.en: Operational limits and action limits

blocks.zh: 成果3：PPQ就緒（Stage 2 Readiness）
blocks.en: Outcome 3: PPQ Readiness (Stage 2 Readiness)

blocks.zh: Stage 1最重要的輸出，是讓Stage 2 PPQ有科學基礎：
blocks.en: The most important output of Stage 1 is giving the Stage 2 PPQ a scientific foundation:

blocks.zh: PPQ要測什麼？→ 來自Stage 1識別的CPP和CQA
blocks.en: What should PPQ test? -> From the CPPs and CQAs identified in Stage 1

blocks.zh: 測多少批次？→ 基於Stage 1評估的變異範圍和風險等級
blocks.en: How many batches? -> Based on the variability range and risk level assessed in Stage 1

blocks.zh: 用什麼驗收標準？→ 來自Stage 1設定的CQA規格和PAR
blocks.en: What acceptance criteria? -> From the CQA specifications and PAR set in Stage 1

blocks.zh: Stage 1做得越扎實，PPQ需要的批次數越少，監管風險越低。
blocks.en: The more solid the Stage 1 work, the fewer batches PPQ requires and the lower the regulatory risk.

blocks.zh: Stage 1 = 投資，不是成本
blocks.en: Stage 1 = Investment, Not Cost

blocks.zh: 許多公司（尤其在快速開發壓力下）把Stage 1視為「必要的文書工作」。FDA和業界實踐都告訴我們：
blocks.en: Many companies (especially under rapid-development pressure) treat Stage 1 as "necessary paperwork". FDA and industry practice both show that:

blocks.zh: 在Stage 1每投入1元的製程理解工作，在Stage 2可以省下5–10元的失敗批次成本
blocks.en: Every unit of currency invested in process understanding work in Stage 1 can save 5-10 units of failed-batch cost in Stage 2

blocks.zh: 在Stage 1每省1元（跳過DOE或記錄），在Stage 3的偏差調查和CAPA中可能付出10元的代價
blocks.en: Every unit saved in Stage 1 (by skipping DOE or documentation) can cost 10 units in deviation investigations and CAPA in Stage 3

blocks.zh: 對CDMO的操作總監而言，Stage 1的嚴謹性是品質文化的展現，也是商業競爭力的基礎。
blocks.en: For a CDMO's head of operations, the rigor of Stage 1 is a demonstration of quality culture and the foundation of commercial competitiveness.

blocks.zh: 最終綜合練習
blocks.en: Final Integrated Exercise

blocks.zh: 整合思考：一個新的mAb無菌注射劑從Sponsor技術轉移至您的CDMO，計畫6個月後進行Stage 2 PPQ。請設計一個Stage 1工作計畫，說明：（a）需要評估的CPP和CMA清單；（b）需要進行的補充研究類型；（c）最終PDR的主要章節。
blocks.en: Integrated thinking: a new mAb sterile injectable is being transferred from the sponsor to your CDMO, with Stage 2 PPQ planned in 6 months. Design a Stage 1 work plan that specifies: (a) the list of CPPs and CMAs to be evaluated; (b) the types of supplementary studies to be performed; (c) the main sections of the final PDR.

blocks.zh: FDA 2011 Guidance強調「建立品質而非測試品質（Build quality in, don't test quality in）」。Stage 1的哪三個活動最能體現這個哲學？為什麼？
blocks.en: The FDA 2011 guidance emphasizes "build quality in, don't test quality in". Which three Stage 1 activities best embody this philosophy? Why?

blocks.zh: 如果您是一名FDA調查員，在稽查一個CDMO的Stage 1記錄，您最想看到哪三份文件？如果這三份文件缺失或不完整，您會提出什麼483觀察項？
blocks.en: If you were an FDA investigator inspecting a CDMO's Stage 1 records, which three documents would you most want to see? If these three documents were missing or incomplete, what 483 observations would you raise?

blocks.zh: Stage 1 Complete Summary | 第一階段完整總結
blocks.en: Stage 1 Complete Summary
